title: SpecKCast: Spectral Kalman Forecasting for Diffusion Acceleration
title_zh: SpecKCast：用于扩散加速的谱卡尔曼预测方法

paragraphs.en: SpecKCast提出基于频域卡尔曼滤波的无训练扩散模型加速方法，在多个模型上实现最高6倍加速且额外内存不足0.05 GiB。 Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) achieve high-fidelity image and video generation, but they suffer from substantial inference costs due to repeated transformer evaluations across many denoising steps. Feature caching reduces this cost by reusing features across denoising steps. Recent forecasting methods extend this idea by extrapolating features to skipped steps instead of reusing them. However, existing forecasting methods extrapolate the features they predict uniformly, even though the spatial-frequency components of these features change most at different stages of denoising. They also overlook that denoising progresses nonuniformly, so equal step intervals can correspond to very different amounts of change. These mismatches amplify forecast errors as more steps are skipped, limiting the achievable acceleration. We propose SpecKCast, a training-free method that forecasts the model output in the frequency domain. SpecKCast applies a 2D discrete cosine transform (DCT) to the output and tracks each coefficient with a lightweight Kalman filter along a band-specific time coordinate derived from the noise schedule. The filter tracks each coefficient's value and rate of change, and the transformer is evaluated only when the filter's forecast uncertainty exceeds a threshold. Experiments on FLUX.1-dev, Qwen-Image, Wan2.1-14B, and HunyuanVideo show that SpecKCast achieves a better trade-off between acceleration and fidelity than existing caching and forecasting methods, reaching up to 6x speedup with less than 0.05 GiB of additional memory.
paragraphs.zh: SpecKCast 提出了一种基于频域卡尔曼滤波的无训练扩散模型加速方法，在多个模型上实现最高 6 倍加速且额外内存不足 0.05 GiB。扩散变压器在图像和视频生成中实现了高保真度，但由于在多个去噪步骤中反复进行变压器评估，其推理成本高昂。 特征缓存通过在去噪步骤之间复用特征来降低这一成本。 近期的预测方法扩展了这一思路，不再复用特征，而是将特征外推到被跳过的步骤。 然而，现有的预测方法对其预测的特征进行均匀外推，尽管这些特征的空间-频率分量在去噪的不同阶段变化程度最大。 它们还忽略了去噪是非均匀推进的这一事实，因此相同的步数间隔可能对应差异很大的变化量。 这些不匹配随着跳过步数的增多而放大预测误差，限制了可实现的加速。 我们提出 SpecKCast，一种在频域预测模型输出的免训练方法。 SpecKCast 对输出应用二维离散余弦变换（DCT），并使用轻量级卡尔曼滤波器沿由噪声调度导出的特定频带时间坐标跟踪每个系数。 该滤波器跟踪每个系数的值及其变化率，并且仅当滤波器的预测不确定性超过阈值时才评估智能体。 在 FLUX.1-dev、Qwen-Image、Wan2.1-14B 和 HunyuanVideo 上的实验表明，SpecKCast 在加速与保真度之间实现了优于现有缓存和预测方法的权衡，最高可达 6 倍加速且额外内存不足 0.05 GiB。
